text:
noah: Urgent — VerdantThera CISO escalated; they will not proceed with integration until we resolve BYOK for model keys, EU-only processing for the POC, SCIM delegated-admin for their Okta team, and they require a pen-test summary + SOC2 doc. They also want a firm price for a 6-week POC and a throughput SLA. Can we get owners? @maya @jia
maya: I'll run the exec bridge. propose 3pm PT. Need a 1-slide summary: blockers, asks, and two pricing paths (metered vs reserved). Can someone own BYOK and residency wording?
jia: SE — I can own BYOK/KMS. Quick nuance: we support customer KMS wrap in Dedicated and Private; automated BYOK rotation for hosted is not supported. For the POC we can do a manual rotation workflow with audit logs. I'll draft a short integration note by 1pm PT.
ben: Eng-telemetry here — if they want packet-capture or network-level testing, we need an SOW and dedicated tunnel. Pen-test artifacts require NDA. Also for SCIM delegated-admin: we do user/group sync today but delegated admin ACLs would need an infra change. Alternative: SE-managed admin proxy for the pilot.
claire: Legal — confirm SOC2 link: Confluence > Compliance > SOC2-2026-redacted. Pen-test sharing requires mutual NDA; I'll prepare an NDA template and a limited pilot addendum that commits to EU processing for the pilot window. Note: we avoid long-term residency guarantees in pilot addenda.
noah: Their throughput ask: 250 req/s sustained, p99 <= 150ms for chat-gen routes, streaming enabled. They asked for a failover plan and rollback runbook.
maya: For pricing, I suggest: Option A: metered hosted w/ 15% pilot discount; Option B: reserved pilot cluster (3 nodes) w/ flat monthly + ops SOW for BYOK and SCIM proxy. I'll draft numbers and a brief run-rate for autoscaling.
jia: Technical caveat: streaming tails may increase p99; we'll include a note and propose a short perf window in eu-west-1 using sanitized payloads. Need sample payloads and test token from Verdant.
ben: I'll prepare an infra checklist: network peering, egress rules, logging retention, and deletion confirmation at pilot end. Also will coordinate with eng-sre for any trace-level debugging.
claire: Action items: I'll put NDA + pilot addendum draft in legal queue. Add subject "VerdantThera pen-test". Also require customer to confirm who will receive pen-test artifacts (list of recipients).
ops-bot: ticket created: VTHERA-3091 "VerdantThera POC exec escalation: BYOK + EU residency + SCIM + SLA" Assigned: se-oncall, infra-pilot, legal-queue.
maya: Exec bridge scheduled 2026-02-21T15:00:00-07:00. I'll send invites to Verdant stakeholders and internal owners. Please have slide and BYOK note in this thread before 14:00 PT.
noah: I'll DM Verdant for sample payloads and the exact questionnaire version. Also asked for procurement to confirm pilot billing contact.
maya: Thanks — will post slide + numbers by 13:45 PT. Claire, please ping when NDA + addendum are ready. Jia/Ben thanks for owning tech pieces.
claire: NDA draft uploaded to Confluence > NDAs > Verdant-pentest-template. Will update thread when ready.
noah: Closing loop for now; will update with questionnaire and payloads. :white_check_mark:
